display.label: Key Vault
display.description: Azure Key Vault for safeguarding cryptographic keys, secrets, and certificates

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Key Vault. Serves as the map key.

fields.label: Key Vault Name
fields.description: Globally unique name for the Key Vault. Must be 3-24 characters, contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens, start with a letter, and end with a letter or digit.

validation.pattern_error: Key Vault name must be 3-24 characters, start with a letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Key Vault.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Key Vault should be created.

fields.label: SKU Name
fields.description: The SKU tier used for this Key Vault. Standard supports software-protected keys and secrets. Premium adds HSM-protected keys.

options.label: Premium (Includes Hardware Security Module HSM-protected keys)

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure Active Directory Tenant ID used for authenticating requests to the Key Vault.

fields.label: RBAC Authorization Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether Azure Key Vault uses Role-Based Access Control (Azure RBAC) for authorization of data actions (Recommended). When true, access policies are not used.

sections.label: Security & Recovery Settings
sections.description: Integration, recovery, and access settings for the Key Vault.

fields.label: Enabled for Deployment
fields.description: Specifies whether Azure Virtual Machines are permitted to retrieve certificates stored as secrets from the vault.

fields.label: Enabled for Disk Encryption
fields.description: Specifies whether Azure Disk Encryption is permitted to retrieve secrets from the vault and unwrap keys.

fields.label: Enabled for Template Deployment
fields.description: Specifies whether Azure Resource Manager is permitted to retrieve secrets from the vault during ARM template deployments.

fields.label: Purge Protection Enabled
fields.description: Prevents the Key Vault and its contents from being permanently deleted until the soft-delete retention period expires. Once enabled, cannot be disabled.

fields.label: Soft-Delete Retention Days
fields.description: The number of days that items should be retained for once soft-deleted. Must be between 7 and 90 days.

fields.label: Public Network Access Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether public network traffic is allowed to access the Key Vault.

sections.label: Network ACLs
sections.description: Network firewall rules restricting access to the Key Vault.

fields.label: Network ACLs Configuration
fields.description: Firewall configuration for the Key Vault.

fields.label: Default Action
fields.description: The default action when no rule matches from ip_rules or virtual_network_subnet_ids.

fields.label: Bypass
fields.description: Specifies which traffic can bypass the network rules.

fields.label: Allowed IP Rules
fields.description: List of IPv4 CIDR blocks allowed to access the Key Vault.

fields.label: Allowed Subnet IDs
fields.description: List of virtual network subnet IDs allowed to access the Key Vault.

sections.label: Access Policies
sections.description: Inline Key Vault access policies when RBAC authorization is disabled.

fields.label: Access Policies
fields.description: List of access policies for identities accessing the Key Vault.

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure Active Directory Tenant ID.

fields.label: Object ID
fields.description: The Azure AD Object ID of the user, service principal, or security group.

fields.label: Application ID
fields.description: Optional Application ID for compound identity authorization.

fields.label: Key Permissions
fields.description: List of key permissions (e.g. Get, List, Create, Delete, Encrypt, Decrypt).

fields.label: Secret Permissions
fields.description: List of secret permissions (e.g. Get, List, Set, Delete).

fields.label: Certificate Permissions
fields.description: List of certificate permissions (e.g. Get, List, Create, Delete).

fields.label: Storage Permissions
fields.description: List of storage account permissions.

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the Key Vault.
